project.title: Signal Loom
project.pitch: A synthetic project that weaves loose signals into one readable fabric.

story.heading: Loose threads everywhere
story.body: Signals arrive unordered, and nobody can read the pattern they make.

story.heading: A loom for signals
story.body: Eight warp threads hold the order while a single weft carries each new signal across.

story.heading: Cloth you can read
story.body: The fixture fabric holds its pattern from the first thread to the selvedge.

screenshots.alt: Draft plate of eight violet warp threads crossed by a single pale weft.
